final_text:
The P0 sample has 10 spiked organisms. Five are at species level with at least 10 clade reads, and five are not.

| Organism | Species row (S) clade reads | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Pseudomonas aeruginosa | 811 | detected |
| Enterococcus faecalis | 6457 | detected |
| Escherichia coli | 72 | detected |
| Staphylococcus aureus | 54 | detected |
| Lactobacillus fermentum (report: Limosilactobacillus fermentum) | 26 | detected |
| Salmonella enterica | 4 | missed (below 10) |
| Bacillus subtilis | 2 | missed (below 10) |
| Listeria monocytogenes | no species row (genus Listeria has 315 reads) | missed |
| Saccharomyces cerevisiae | not in report | missed |
| Cryptococcus neoformans | not in report | missed |

I read the report directly with zcat and grep rather than running `mockcheck`.
